name: Custom Profile Image
description: Upload a custom PNG as your in-game avatar or namecard, bypassing the in-game camera requirement.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Custom Profile Image window — pick a PNG, follow the on-screen steps, and apply it as your avatar or namecard.

fixed: Custom images now upload reliably even when your Windows account folder, your picture, or the game itself is in a folder with non-English characters (for example Japanese or Chinese). Before, the upload could silently do nothing.
changed: Avatar and Namecard now share a single "Make Avatar/Namecard" button and one selected image — it is applied automatically to whichever one you change in-game.
added: The window now shows step-by-step instructions and the recommended image sizes, and upload status messages are clearer and translated into your language.
